🛑 CRITICAL STATUTORY DIRECTIVE: UNIVERSITY UNION COUNCILLOR (UUC) COUNTING RESTRICTION MANDATORY RO CLEARANCE
COUNT UNIVERSITY UNION COUNCILLOR (UUC) BALLOTS ONLY AND STRICTLY AFTER DIRECT VERBAL OR WRITTEN ORDER & CLEARANCE FROM THE RETURNING OFFICER (RO).
1. DO NOT OPEN OR UNSEAL: The sealed packets containing University Union Councillor (UUC) ballot papers must remain strictly locked/sealed in the secure table tray while Stages 1, 2, and 3 are in progress.
2. CENTRAL CONSOLIDATION: UUC seats involve a campus-wide multi-candidate quota system requiring simultaneous hall-wide tallying across all 30 counting tables.
3. OFFICIAL RO GREEN SIGNAL: Counting of UUC shall commence ONLY after the Returning Officer officially rings the signal bell and announces the hall-wide start of UUC counting. Premature unsealing violates statutory bylaws.
⚙️ STANDARD OPERATING INSTRUCTIONS FOR COUNTING TABLE OFFICIALS STATUTORY COMPLIANCE REQUIRED
1
Seal & Account Audit: Before opening ballot box, verify Strip Seal & Special Tag numbers against Form 2 (Ballot Paper Account) in the presence of Counting Agents.
2
25-Ballot Standard Bundles: Unfold ballots face up, verify statutory stamp, and sort into neat bundles of exactly 25 valid ballots, tied securely with paper slips.
3
Zero Table Rejection: Table officials have no authority to reject ballots. Put all doubtful ballots into the Doubtful Tray for sole adjudication by the RO.
4
Agent Perimeter Discipline: Counting agents must remain behind the table barrier. Agents may observe and note totals, but are strictly prohibited from touching ballots.
5
Sign-off & Handover: Supervisor records scores in Form 6, obtains signatures of candidate agents, and personally carries the signed return to the central RO Tabulation Desk.
6
Secrecy & Prohibitions: Mobile phones, cameras, and unauthorized pens are strictly barred at counting tables. Only green/red pens of the Supervisor are permitted for marking.

🛑 CRITICAL STATUTORY DIRECTIVE: UNIVERSITY UNION COUNCILLOR (UUC) COUNTING RESTRICTION MANDATORY RO CLEARANCE
COUNT UNIVERSITY UNION COUNCILLOR (UUC) BALLOTS ONLY AND STRICTLY AFTER DIRECT VERBAL OR WRITTEN ORDER & CLEARANCE FROM THE RETURNING OFFICER (RO).
1. DO NOT OPEN OR UNSEAL: The sealed packets containing University Union Councillor (UUC) ballot papers must remain strictly locked/sealed in the secure table tray while Stages 1, 2, and 3 are in progress.
2. CENTRAL CONSOLIDATION: UUC seats involve a campus-wide multi-candidate quota system requiring simultaneous hall-wide tallying across all 30 counting tables.
3. OFFICIAL RO GREEN SIGNAL: Counting of UUC shall commence ONLY after the Returning Officer officially rings the signal bell and announces the hall-wide start of UUC counting. Premature unsealing violates statutory bylaws.
⚙️ STANDARD OPERATING INSTRUCTIONS FOR COUNTING TABLE OFFICIALS STATUTORY COMPLIANCE REQUIRED
1
Seal & Account Audit: Before opening ballot box, verify Strip Seal & Special Tag numbers against Form 2 (Ballot Paper Account) in the presence of Counting Agents.
2
25-Ballot Standard Bundles: Unfold ballots face up, verify statutory stamp, and sort into neat bundles of exactly 25 valid ballots, tied securely with paper slips.
3
Zero Table Rejection: Table officials have no authority to reject ballots. Put all doubtful ballots into the Doubtful Tray for sole adjudication by the RO.
4
Agent Perimeter Discipline: Counting agents must remain behind the table barrier. Agents may observe and note totals, but are strictly prohibited from touching ballots.
5
Sign-off & Handover: Supervisor records scores in Form 6, obtains signatures of candidate agents, and personally carries the signed return to the central RO Tabulation Desk.
6
Secrecy & Prohibitions: Mobile phones, cameras, and unauthorized pens are strictly barred at counting tables. Only green/red pens of the Supervisor are permitted for marking.

3. OFFICIAL RO GREEN SIGNAL: Counting of UUC shall commence ONLY after the Returning Officer officially rings the signal bell and announces the hall-wide start of UUC counting. Premature unsealing violates statutory bylaws.
⚙️ STANDARD OPERATING INSTRUCTIONS FOR COUNTING TABLE OFFICIALS STATUTORY COMPLIANCE REQUIRED
1
Seal & Account Audit: Before opening ballot box, verify Strip Seal & Special Tag numbers against Form 2 (Ballot Paper Account) in the presence of Counting Agents.
2
25-Ballot Standard Bundles: Unfold ballots face up, verify statutory stamp, and sort into neat bundles of exactly 25 valid ballots, tied securely with paper slips.
3
Zero Table Rejection: Table officials have no authority to reject ballots. Put all doubtful ballots into the Doubtful Tray for sole adjudication by the RO.
4
Agent Perimeter Discipline: Counting agents must remain behind the table barrier. Agents may observe and note totals, but are strictly prohibited from touching ballots.
5
Sign-off & Handover: Supervisor records scores in Form 6, obtains signatures of candidate agents, and personally carries the signed return to the central RO Tabulation Desk.
6
Secrecy & Prohibitions: Mobile phones, cameras, and unauthorized pens are strictly barred at counting tables. Only green/red pens of the Supervisor are permitted for marking.

🛑 CRITICAL STATUTORY DIRECTIVE: UNIVERSITY UNION COUNCILLOR (UUC) COUNTING RESTRICTION MANDATORY RO CLEARANCE
COUNT UNIVERSITY UNION COUNCILLOR (UUC) BALLOTS ONLY AND STRICTLY AFTER DIRECT VERBAL OR WRITTEN ORDER & CLEARANCE FROM THE RETURNING OFFICER (RO).
1. DO NOT OPEN OR UNSEAL: The sealed packets containing University Union Councillor (UUC) ballot papers must remain strictly locked/sealed in the secure table tray while Stages 1, 2, and 3 are in progress.
2. CENTRAL CONSOLIDATION: UUC seats involve a campus-wide multi-candidate quota system requiring simultaneous hall-wide tallying across all 30 counting tables.
3. OFFICIAL RO GREEN SIGNAL: Counting of UUC shall commence ONLY after the Returning Officer officially rings the signal bell and announces the hall-wide start of UUC counting. Premature unsealing violates statutory bylaws.
⚙️ STANDARD OPERATING INSTRUCTIONS FOR COUNTING TABLE OFFICIALS STATUTORY COMPLIANCE REQUIRED
1
Seal & Account Audit: Before opening ballot box, verify Strip Seal & Special Tag numbers against Form 2 (Ballot Paper Account) in the presence of Counting Agents.
2
25-Ballot Standard Bundles: Unfold ballots face up, verify statutory stamp, and sort into neat bundles of exactly 25 valid ballots, tied securely with paper slips.
3
Zero Table Rejection: Table officials have no authority to reject ballots. Put all doubtful ballots into the Doubtful Tray for sole adjudication by the RO.
4
Agent Perimeter Discipline: Counting agents must remain behind the table barrier. Agents may observe and note totals, but are strictly prohibited from touching ballots.
5
Sign-off & Handover: Supervisor records scores in Form 6, obtains signatures of candidate agents, and personally carries the signed return to the central RO Tabulation Desk.
6
Secrecy & Prohibitions: Mobile phones, cameras, and unauthorized pens are strictly barred at counting tables. Only green/red pens of the Supervisor are permitted for marking.

🛑 CRITICAL STATUTORY DIRECTIVE: UNIVERSITY UNION COUNCILLOR (UUC) COUNTING RESTRICTION MANDATORY RO CLEARANCE
COUNT UNIVERSITY UNION COUNCILLOR (UUC) BALLOTS ONLY AND STRICTLY AFTER DIRECT VERBAL OR WRITTEN ORDER & CLEARANCE FROM THE RETURNING OFFICER (RO).
1. DO NOT OPEN OR UNSEAL: The sealed packets containing University Union Councillor (UUC) ballot papers must remain strictly locked/sealed in the secure table tray while Stages 1, 2, and 3 are in progress.
2. CENTRAL CONSOLIDATION: UUC seats involve a campus-wide multi-candidate quota system requiring simultaneous hall-wide tallying across all 30 counting tables.
3. OFFICIAL RO GREEN SIGNAL: Counting of UUC shall commence ONLY after the Returning Officer officially rings the signal bell and announces the hall-wide start of UUC counting. Premature unsealing violates statutory bylaws.
⚙️ STANDARD OPERATING INSTRUCTIONS FOR COUNTING TABLE OFFICIALS STATUTORY COMPLIANCE REQUIRED
1
Seal & Account Audit: Before opening ballot box, verify Strip Seal & Special Tag numbers against Form 2 (Ballot Paper Account) in the presence of Counting Agents.
2
25-Ballot Standard Bundles: Unfold ballots face up, verify statutory stamp, and sort into neat bundles of exactly 25 valid ballots, tied securely with paper slips.
3
Zero Table Rejection: Table officials have no authority to reject ballots. Put all doubtful ballots into the Doubtful Tray for sole adjudication by the RO.
4
Agent Perimeter Discipline: Counting agents must remain behind the table barrier. Agents may observe and note totals, but are strictly prohibited from touching ballots.
5
Sign-off & Handover: Supervisor records scores in Form 6, obtains signatures of candidate agents, and personally carries the signed return to the central RO Tabulation Desk.
6
Secrecy & Prohibitions: Mobile phones, cameras, and unauthorized pens are strictly barred at counting tables. Only green/red pens of the Supervisor are permitted for marking.
